voice.nameHowTo: Kneeling push-ups. Kneel with your hands a little wider than your shoulders. Keep a straight line from your knees to your head, lower your chest towards the floor, then press back up.
Commando plank. Start in a plank on your elbows. Push up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank. Lower back down one elbow at a time. Keep your hips steady and don't rock side to side.
Wide grip push-ups. Set your hands well outside your shoulders, legs straight behind you. Keep your body in one line as you lower your chest towards the floor, then push back up.

Diamond push-ups. Bring your hands together under your chest so your thumbs and fingers make a diamond. Keep your elbows close to your sides as you lower down, then press back up. Drop to your knees if you need to.
Pike push-ups. From a plank, walk your feet in and lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V. Bend your elbows to bring the top of your head towards the floor, then push back up.
Archer push-ups. Set your hands very wide. Lower your chest towards one hand while the other arm stays straight out to the side, then push back up and go the other way. Keep your hips level.
Kneeling archer push-ups. On your knees, set your hands very wide. Shift your weight and lower towards one hand while the other arm stays straight, then press up and go the other way.
Kneeling push-ups to down dog. Do one push-up from your knees. Then lift your knees and push your hips up and back into downward dog. Come back down to your knees and repeat.

Reverse plank tricep dips. Sit with your hands behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet, and lift your hips. Bend your elbows to dip down, then straighten them to press back up. Keep your hips lifted.
Single leg push-ups. Get into a push-up position and lift one foot off the floor. Keep it raised as you lower your chest and press back up. Keep your hips level and your stomach tight.

Wave push-up. From a plank, lower your hips first and then your chest, as if rolling down to the floor. Push your chest up into a gentle cobra, then lift your hips back to plank. Make it one smooth wave.
Airplane push-ups. Lower into a push-up. As you press back up, reach one arm out to the side like a wing. Bring it back down and repeat with the other arm.
Hindu push-ups. Start in downward dog with your hips high. Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward, close to the floor, then up into a cobra. Push your hips back up to the start.
Kneeling pseudo push-ups. On your knees, place your hands by your waist with your fingers turned out. Lean your shoulders forward past your hands, then lower your chest and press back up.
Kneeling push-ups, hands off. Do a push-up from your knees and lower all the way to the floor. Lift your hands off the ground for a moment, put them back down and press up.

moves.name: Mountain Climber to Push-Ups from Knees

voice.nameOnly: Mountain climber to push-ups from knees.
voice.nameHowTo: Mountain climber to push-ups from knees. In a high plank, drive your knees towards your chest a few times. Then drop your knees to the floor, do one push-up, and go straight back into the climbers.

sourceNames: Mountain Climber to Push-Ups from Knees
Mountain Climber to Push-ups from Knees

voice.nameHowTo: Scapular push-ups. Hold a plank with straight arms. Without bending your elbows, let your chest sink so your shoulder blades squeeze together, then push the floor away to spread them apart.
Walkouts to push-ups. From standing, fold forward and put your hands on the floor. Walk them out to a plank, do one push-up, then walk your hands back to your feet and stand up.

Assisted one-arm push-ups. Put one hand under your chest and the other out wide on its fingertips. Lower down, letting the main arm do most of the work, then press back up. Drop to your knees if you need to.
Narrow grip kneeling push-ups. On your knees, place your hands close together, just under your shoulders. Keep your elbows tucked in by your ribs as you lower your chest, then press back up.
Narrow grip push-ups. In a plank, place your hands close together under your shoulders. Keep your elbows tight to your sides as you lower down, then push back up in one straight line.
Prayer pulse. Sit or kneel tall and press your palms together in front of your chest. Push your hands hard into each other, then pulse them forward and back in small movements. Keep the pressure on.
Pseudo push-ups. In a plank, turn your fingers out and place your hands by your waist. Lean your shoulders forward past your hands, then lower your chest and press back up. Keep your body straight.
Push-ups. Hands just wider than your shoulders, legs straight behind you. Keep your body in one line as you lower your chest close to the floor, then push back up. Don't let your hips drop.
Superman. Lie face down with your arms stretched out in front. Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor together, hold for a moment, then lower with control. Keep looking down at the floor.
Bird dogs. Start on all fours. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until they're level with your back. Pause, bring them in, then swap sides. Keep your hips square to the floor.

moves.name: Back Bow with Alternating Heel Taps

voice.nameOnly: Back bow with alternating heel taps.
voice.nameHowTo: Back bow with alternating heel taps. Lie face down and lift your chest off the floor. Bend one knee and reach back to tap that heel with your hand, then swap sides. Keep your chest lifted the whole time.

sourceNames: Back Bow with Alternating Heel Taps

voice.nameHowTo: Hip thrust. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Drive through your heels and thrust your hips up hard, squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower with control.
Back bow with heel taps. Lie face down and lift your chest off the floor. Bend both knees and reach back to tap your heels with both hands, then straighten your legs. Keep your chest lifted.
Elbow to knee bird dogs. On all fours, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back. Then curl them in under your body until your elbow meets your knee, and stretch out again.

Reverse forearm plank. Sit with your legs straight and your elbows on the floor under your shoulders, behind you. Lift your hips until your body is in one straight line, facing the ceiling, and hold. Squeeze your glutes.
Glute bridge. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat, close to your hips. Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until you're straight from knees to shoulders. Lower slowly.

Bodyweight squat. Feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly. Sit your hips back and down as if onto a chair, keeping your chest up and your knees in line with your toes. Push through your heels to stand.
Sumo squat. Stand with your feet wide and your toes turned out. Lower your hips straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes. Keep your chest up, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
Reverse glute raise. Lie face down with your forehead resting on your hands. Keep your legs straight and lift them both off the floor using your glutes. Pause, then lower slowly.
Donkey kicks. On all fours, keep one knee bent and kick that foot up towards the ceiling, sole facing up. Squeeze your glute at the top, lower, and repeat. Keep your back flat.
Lizard lunge. Step one foot forward to the outside of your hands in a deep lunge, back knee down. Let your hips sink towards the floor and hold the stretch. Drop to your forearms if you can.
Five o'clock lunges. Stand tall. Step one leg back and out on a diagonal, like the hand of a clock, and sink into a lunge. Push back up to standing and repeat.
Alternating forward lunge. Step forward and lower until both knees are bent at about a right angle. Push back to standing, then step forward with the other leg. Keep your chest tall.

Glute bridges with abduction. Lift into a glute bridge with your knees bent and your feet flat. At the top, push your knees out to the sides and back in, then lower your hips. Keep squeezing your glutes.
Hip thrust to knee strike. Lie on your back with your knees bent. Lift your hips into a bridge and drive one knee up towards your chest at the top. Lower your foot and your hips, and repeat.
Side lunges. Stand with your feet together. Take a big step out to the side, bend that knee and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight. Push back to the middle and repeat.
Squats with kickback. Lower into a squat. As you stand up, kick one leg straight back and squeeze your glute. Squat again and kick back with the other leg.
Alternating glute bridge hold. Lift your hips into a bridge and hold them there. Straighten one leg out, put it back down, then straighten the other. Keep your hips high and level the whole time.
Curtsey lunges. Stand tall. Cross one leg behind the other and out to the side, as if curtseying, and bend both knees. Push back up to standing and repeat.
Glute bridge hold. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Lift your hips until you're straight from knees to shoulders, and hold. Keep squeezing your glutes and breathe steadily.
Pivot lunge. From a wide stance, pivot on the balls of your feet to turn sideways and drop into a lunge. Pivot back to face the front and repeat.
Prisoner squat. Put your hands behind your head, elbows wide. Sit your hips back and down into a squat, keeping your chest lifted and your elbows open, then stand back up.
Side step squats. Take a step out to the side and lower into a squat. Stand up, bring your feet together, and step out the other way. Keep your chest up.
Backward lunges. Stand tall and step one foot back, lowering until both knees are bent. Push through your front heel to come back to standing. Keep your front knee over your ankle.

moves.name: Glute Bridge Hold with Knee to Chest

voice.nameOnly: Glute bridge hold with knee to chest.
voice.nameHowTo: Glute bridge hold with knee to chest. Hold your hips up in a glute bridge. Bring one knee in towards your chest, put the foot back down, then switch legs. Don't let your hips drop.

sourceNames: Bridge Hold with Knee to Chest
Glute Bridge Hold with Knee to Chest

voice.nameHowTo: Squat with calf raise. Lower into a squat, then drive up to standing and keep going onto your tiptoes. Lower your heels and squat again. Move with control.
Elbow plank. Elbows under your shoulders, legs straight out behind you. Brace your stomach and hold your body in one straight line, with no sagging or lifting at the hips. Keep breathing.

Leg raises. Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides. Press your lower back into the floor, lift your legs until they point at the ceiling, then lower them slowly without touching down.

Dead bug. Lie on your back with your arms pointing at the ceiling and your knees bent over your hips. Lower one arm and the opposite leg towards the floor, bring them back, then switch. Keep your lower back down.
Sit up. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat. Curl your chest up towards your knees until you're sitting up, then roll back down slowly. Lead with your chest, not your neck.

Spider and cross plank. In a high plank, bring one knee out to the side towards the elbow on that side, then back. Next, bring it across your body towards the opposite elbow. Repeat on the other side.

Windshield wipers. Lie on your back with your arms out wide and lift your knees above your hips. Let them drop slowly to one side, then sweep them across to the other. Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
Airplane plank. From a high plank, lift one arm out to the side like a wing, put it back down, then lift the other. Keep your hips square and still.
Kayak abs. Sit with your knees bent and lean back a little, feet lifted. Clasp your hands and twist from side to side as if paddling a kayak. Keep your chest up.
Flutter kicks. Lie on your back with your hands under your hips. Lift your legs a little off the floor and kick them up and down in small, quick movements. Keep your lower back pressed down.
Heel taps. Lie on your back with your knees bent and your shoulders lifted off the floor. Reach from side to side to tap each heel with your hand. Keep your stomach tight.
L-crunch. Lie on your back with one leg pointing at the ceiling and the other straight on the floor. Reach your hands up towards the raised foot, lifting your shoulders, then lower slowly.
Modified diagonal mountain climber. In a high plank, step one knee across towards the opposite elbow, then step it back. Switch legs. Keep a steady pace, no jumping.
Seated knee tucks. Sit and lean back on your hands with your legs out and lifted. Pull your knees in towards your chest, then push your legs back out. Keep your feet off the floor.
Wood chops. Stand with your feet wide and clasp your hands above one shoulder. Swing them down diagonally across your body towards the opposite hip, turning your chest, then bring them back up.
Side plank. Lie on your side and prop yourself up on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder. Lift your hips so you're straight from head to feet, and hold. Don't let your hips sink.
Standing side crunch. Stand with one hand behind your head. Lift that knee out to the side and bring your elbow down to meet it, crunching through your side. Return and repeat.
V sit bicycles. Sit and lean back into a V with your feet off the floor. Pedal your legs as if riding a bike, twisting to bring each elbow towards the opposite knee. Keep your chest lifted.
Overhead sit ups. Lie on your back with your arms stretched overhead. Keep your arms by your ears as you sit all the way up, then roll back down slowly. Keep your feet on the floor.
Shoulder taps. Hold a high plank with your feet a little apart. Lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder, put it back down, then switch. Keep your hips as still as you can.
Suitcase sit up. Lie flat with your arms stretched past your head. In one move, fold up and bring your knees and chest together, like closing a suitcase. Unfold slowly back to the floor.

Extended suitcase crunch. Lie with your arms overhead and your legs straight, just off the floor. Crunch up, pulling your knees in and reaching your arms forward to meet them, then stretch back out without resting.
High plank walk out. From standing, fold down and walk your hands forward into a high plank. Hold for a moment, then walk your hands back to your feet and stand up.
Plank to kick back. In a high plank, bring one knee towards your chest, then kick that leg straight back and up. Return to plank and repeat with the other leg.
Raised scorpion. Lie face down with your arms out wide. Lift one leg, bend the knee and twist your hips to reach that foot across towards the opposite hand. Return slowly.

Scissor kicks. Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and your legs straight and lifted a little. Cross one leg over the other, then switch, in a quick scissor movement. Keep your lower back down.
Hollow body hold. Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor. Lift your shoulders and your straight legs off the ground, reach your arms forward, and hold that curved shape.
Burpee walk. From standing, bend down and put your hands on the floor. Step your feet back one at a time into a plank, step them forward again and stand up. No jumping, just keep a steady rhythm.
Burpees. Squat down and put your hands on the floor. Jump your feet back into a plank, jump them back in, then jump up with your arms overhead. Land softly and go again.
Squat to walkout. Lower into a squat and put your hands on the floor. Walk your hands out into a plank, walk them back in, then stand up. Keep a steady pace.
Shadow boxing. Stand with your feet staggered and your hands up by your face. Throw quick punches straight ahead, one arm then the other, and stay light on your feet. Keep your guard up.
High knees. Run on the spot, driving your knees up to hip height. Pump your arms and land lightly on the balls of your feet. Keep your chest tall.
Squat jumps. Lower into a squat, then jump up as high as you can. Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
Jump plank. Hold a high plank. Jump both feet out wide and back together, like a jumping jack. Keep your hips low and your shoulders over your hands.
Butt kicks. Jog on the spot, kicking your heels up towards your glutes. Stay light on your feet and keep your arms moving.
Mountain climber. In a high plank, drive one knee towards your chest, then switch legs quickly, as if running on the spot. Keep your hips low and your shoulders over your hands.
Four point box jumps. Jump forward, to the side, back, then to the other side, as if tracing a square on the floor. Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Plank jack shoulder taps. In a high plank, jump your feet out and back in, then tap each hand to the opposite shoulder. Keep repeating and hold your hips steady.
Dynamic side bends. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Reach one arm up and over your head as you bend to the opposite side, then switch. Keep your hips still and the movement smooth.

Standing hip rotation. Balance on one leg with your hands on your hips. Lift the other knee to hip height, swing it out to the side and lower it, drawing a big slow circle. Hold a wall if you need to.
Elbow rotations. Stand tall with your arms out to the sides. Circle your forearms around your elbows, first one way and then the other. Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Cross-body shoulder stretch. Bring one arm straight across your chest. Use your other hand to hug it in towards you, just above the elbow. Keep your shoulder down and hold the stretch.
Wrist warm-up. Clasp your hands together in front of you and roll your wrists in circles, one way and then the other. Keep it loose and easy.
Chest openers with rotation. Stand tall with your arms out in front. Open one arm out to the side and turn your chest to follow it, then come back and switch sides.
Active calf and hamstring stretch. Put one heel forward with your toes pointing up. Hinge at your hips and reach towards that foot, then stand up and swap legs. Keep your front leg straight.
Deep side to side lunge. Stand with your feet wide. Shift your weight onto one leg and sink low into a side lunge, then move across to the other side. Keep your chest up.

Lunge with thoracic rotation. Step into a lunge and put the opposite hand on the floor inside your front foot. Reach your other arm up to the ceiling, turning your chest to follow it, then lower and repeat.
Roll down. Stand tall and tuck your chin. Roll down slowly, one part of your spine at a time, until your hands reach towards the floor. Then roll back up to standing.
Full lunge leg rolls. Step into a deep lunge with your hands on the floor. Roll onto the outside edge of your front foot so that knee drops out, then roll back. Swap legs halfway.
Malasana squat. Sink into a deep squat with your feet wide and your heels down. Press your palms together and use your elbows to ease your knees apart. Keep your chest lifted.

Ninety ninety flip. Sit with both knees bent at right angles, one leg in front of you and one to the side. Lift your knees and swing them over to the other side so the legs swap. Keep your chest tall.

Pendulum hamstring stretch. Stand on one leg and swing the other forward and back like a pendulum, keeping it straight. Let the swing grow little by little, and swap legs halfway. Hold a wall if you need it.
Side stretch. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Reach one arm up and over your head, leaning to the opposite side until you feel it down your side. Hold and breathe slowly.
Cat to cow stretch. On your hands and knees, breathe in as you let your stomach drop and lift your chest. Breathe out as you round your back up towards the ceiling and tuck your chin. Keep it slow.
Plank to downward dog. From a high plank, lift your hips up and back so your body makes an upside-down V. Ease your heels towards the floor, pause, then come back down to plank.
Child's pose. Kneel, sit back on your heels and fold forward. Stretch your arms out in front of you and rest your forehead on the floor. Let your back soften and breathe slowly.
Knees to chest stretch. Lie on your back and hug both knees into your chest. Let your lower back relax into the floor. You can rock gently from side to side.
Overhead lat stretch. Reach both arms overhead and hold one wrist with the other hand. Lean gently to the side to stretch down your back and side, then switch sides.
Seated hamstring stretch. Sit with your legs straight out in front. Keep your back long and hinge forward from your hips, reaching for your toes. Stop where you feel the stretch and hold.
Seated lower back stretch. Sit tall with your legs out. Bend one knee and cross that foot over the other leg. Hug the knee and turn your chest towards it, looking over your shoulder.

Figure four stretch. Lying face up, bend both knees and plant your feet. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, then thread your hands behind the bottom thigh and draw it towards you. Hold and feel it in your hip.
Hip flexor stretch. Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front. Tuck your hips under and shift forward until you feel a stretch at the front of your back hip. Swap sides halfway.
Spinal twist. Lie on your back with your arms out wide. Bring one knee across your body towards the floor and turn your head the other way. Keep both shoulders down and breathe.
Cobra. Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders. Press up gently to lift your chest, keeping your hips on the floor and your shoulders down. Hold, then lower slowly.
Deep squat with thoracic rotation. Sink into a deep squat. Put one hand on the floor and reach the other arm up to the ceiling, turning your chest. Bring it down and switch sides.
Pigeon pose. From all fours, bring one knee forward behind your wrist and stretch the other leg back. Lower your hips and fold forward over your front leg if it feels good. Breathe into the stretch.
Seated butterfly stretch. Sit tall with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out. Hold your feet and gently bounce your knees towards the floor. Keep your back straight.
Bodyweight row. Lie under a low bar or rings and grip with straight arms, body in one line. Pull your chest up to the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
Bulgarian split squats. Stand in front of a bench and rest one foot on it behind you. Lower into a lunge on your front leg, then push back up. Swap legs halfway.
Calf raises. Stand tall, on a step if you have one. Rise up onto your tiptoes as high as you can, pause, then lower your heels slowly.
Chin up. Hang from a bar with your palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull up until your chin is over the bar, then lower all the way down with control.
Dips. Support yourself on parallel bars or a sturdy edge with straight arms. Bend your elbows to lower your body, then press back up. Keep your shoulders down.
Handstand push up. Kick up into a handstand against a wall. Bend your elbows to lower your head towards the floor, then press back up. Only try this when you're ready.
Hanging leg raise. Hang from a bar with straight arms. Brace your stomach and lift your legs up in front of you, then lower them slowly without swinging.
Pull up. Hang from a bar with your palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders. Pull up until your chin clears the bar, then lower slowly to a full hang.
Quadruped twister. Start on all fours with your knees lifted just off the floor. Twist your hips and kick one leg through underneath you towards the opposite side, then come back and switch.
Plank punches with leg extension. Hold a high plank. Punch one arm forward and lift the opposite leg straight back at the same time. Put them down and switch. Keep your hips level.
Reverse plank. Sit with your legs out straight and your hands on the floor behind you. Press through your hands and raise your hips until you're in one straight line, chest up. Hold it there.

Leg swings, front to back. Stand side-on to a wall or post and hold it for balance. Swing your outside leg forwards and backwards like a pendulum, keeping it relaxed. Let each swing grow a little bigger.

Leg swings, side to side. Face a wall or post and hold it with both hands. Swing one leg across the front of your body, then out to the side. Keep your hips facing forwards and your standing knee soft.

Pogo hops. Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. Bounce quickly on the balls of your feet, knees almost straight and heels just off the ground. Keep each contact short and springy, like the ground is hot.
A-march. Walk forwards tall, driving one knee up to hip height as the opposite arm swings forward. Put each foot down on its ball, right under your hips. Slow, sharp and precise.
A-skips. Skip forwards, driving one knee up to hip height on each skip as the opposite arm swings. Push the ground away under your hips and stay tall. Quick and light, not high.
B-skips. Skip forwards like an A-skip, but as your knee comes up, reach the lower leg out in front, then sweep it down and back under you, pawing the ground. Stay tall and relaxed.

Carioca. Travel sideways, crossing your back leg in front of your lead leg, then behind it, over and over. Let your hips turn while your shoulders stay facing forwards. Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Straight-leg run. Run forwards with your legs almost straight, like scissors. Pull each foot down under your hips and land on the ball of the foot. Stay tall and keep the steps quick.
Bounding. Run forwards with long, springy strides, driving your knee forward and up and pushing hard off the back foot. Float for a moment on each step and swing your arms big to match.
Strides. Build up to about ninety percent of your top speed over the first few seconds, hold it smoothly, then ease off before the end. Fast but relaxed, not a sprint. Keep your shoulders loose.
Standing calf stretch. Put your hands on a wall and step one foot back. Keep that back leg straight and the heel down, then lean in until you feel the stretch in your calf. Hold it there.

Standing quad stretch. Stand tall, holding a wall if you need to. Bend one knee and catch your foot behind you, drawing your heel towards your glutes. Keep your knees together and your hips pushed slightly forward.
